restoration_note: The teaching describes the descent of governance through five discrete degrees (year/month/day/hour/moment = five faculties) and the corresponding shrinkage of human stature, lifespan, fertility, light, and life. Most gaps are letter-level or short-formula completions of recurring phrases (ⲣⲙ̄ⲡⲧⲉⲩⲉ 'years', ⲁⲙⲁⲓ̈ⲏⲏⲥ 'support', ⲛⲟⲁⲙ 'powers', the ordinal series ϣⲁⲣⲡ/ⲥⲛⲉⲩ/ϣⲁⲙⲧ/ϩⲧⲁⲩ/ϯⲟⲩ, ⲛϯⲍⲉ comparison frame, ⲁⲇⲁⲙ + son), strongly constrained by parallels within the chapter. Four gaps remain unrestorable: {7} (14 chars, sentence-end transition with ⲕⲉ-), {27} (4 chars before ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ, particle/circumstantial uncertain), {29} (13 chars after ⲙⲛⲛⲥⲱⲥ launching the next clause), and {31} (uncertain reading ⲛⲉⲩϩⲁ — possibly 'their husbands' but apparatus flags reading itself).
